attr.title: GlitchScope
attr.desc: GlitchScope — plays MP3/FLAC/Ogg/Mod/XM/IT/S3M with real-time MilkDrop visualizations. Comes with demo tracker music. Drop your own files into music/ and enjoy.
attr.inst: Music lives in glitchscope/music/. Add your own MP3/FLAC/Ogg/Mod/XM/IT/S3M files there. Presets are in glitchscope/presets/.
